title: Memory CLI
description: Use this when you need to manage the sox-memory store from the shell — provides memory init|status|list|registry subcommands for store lifecycle, scope selection, and registry inspection. Fully deterministic; zero LLM calls.
author: sox-ecosystem

invocation.description: Call runCli(argv: string[]) where argv starts after 'node <entry>'. Subcommands: init, status, list, registry. All are deterministic; zero LLM calls.

db_path.description: Path to the SQLite memory store file (e.g. ~/.memory/memory.db).
